lines.en: label day40:
scene hall_day
: {i}*Sigh*{/i}
I’m at school early again at Makoto's behest since there is apparently a lot I need to catch up on in terms of grading.
lines.zh: 我又一次在 Makoto 的要求下早早来到学校，因为据说我在批改作业方面有一大堆要补的。

lines.en: How? I have no idea. In fact, I'm beginning to suspect that she might be assigning work behind my back.
lines.zh: 怎么会有一大堆？我完全不知道。事实上，我开始怀疑她是不是在背地里给我派活。

lines.en: But at least I'm able to handle it all online through some virtual gradebook thing she told me about.
lines.zh: 但至少我能通过她告诉我的那个什么电子成绩册，在网上把这些全处理掉。

lines.en: Or at least I'm {i}supposed{/i} to be able to handle it online. It's kind of hard to do that without knowing my login credentials.
lines.zh: 或者说，我本来应{i}该{/i}能在网上处理。不知道登录账号密码的话，这事儿还挺难的。

lines.en: So, here I am wandering the halls of the school and waiting for someone to reset my password so I can actually {i}do{/i} my job.
lines.zh: 于是，我就在这学校的走廊里晃荡，等着谁来重置我的密码，好让我真正{i}干{/i}上活。

lines.en: I swear, it's like this school doesn't even {i}want{/i} me to teach sometimes...
lines.zh: 我发誓，有时候这学校简直像是不{i}想{/i}让我教书一样……

lines.en: scene black
I make my way into the classroom to kill some time as it apparently takes a full hour to make my new login stuff.
lines.zh: 我走进教室想打发时间，因为据说弄好新的登录信息要整整一个小时。

lines.en: I initially planned on using that time to try and figure out a way to ask Makoto to just handle this for me...
lines.zh: 我原本打算利用这段时间，想办法开口让 Makoto 直接替我把这事办了……

lines.en: But a certain someone who decided to show up early today causes me to throw those plans out of the window as soon as I set foot inside the room.
lines.zh: 但某个今天也来得特别早的人，让我一踏进教室就把这些计划全扔出了窗外。

lines.en: scene chikaclass1
: Sensei? What are you doing here so early?
lines.zh: : 老师？你怎么来得这么早？

lines.en: : Losing faith in our educational system when I should probably be losing faith in myself instead.
lines.zh: : 在对我们的教育制度失去信心，而其实我更该对自己失去信心。

lines.en: : Woah. That's kinda deep for this early in the morning.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。一大早说这种话有点深奥啊。

lines.en: : The real answer is that I'm supposed to be doing grading stuff. Unfortunately, circumstances have arisen in which I am unable to do that.
lines.zh: : 真正的答案是，我本该在批改作业。不幸的是，出现了一些状况，让我没法干。

lines.en: : Does this mean we all get A's for doing literally nothing?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着我们什么都不干也能拿 A？

lines.en: : No. It means that you all have blank grades for the foreseeable future. A's are what you {i}would{/i} have if I remembered my password.
lines.zh: : 不是。这意味着在可预见的未来里，你们的成绩栏都是空的。如果我记得密码，你们拿到的才{i}会{/i}是 A。

lines.en: : What are you doing, though? You don't normally come here this early, do you?
lines.zh: : 不过你在干什么？你平时不会来这么早吧？

lines.en: scene chikaclass2
: Not all the time. Just when I have to catch up on stuff.
lines.zh: : 也不是天天。只是有东西要补的时候。

lines.en: : Can't you {i}catch up on stuff{/i} at the dorms? Why do you have to come all the way over here?
lines.zh: : 你不能在宿舍里{i}补{/i}吗？为什么非得大老远跑过来？

lines.en: : Probs cause Yumi was in a bad mood this morning and I didn't want to smack a bitch.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为 Yumi 今天早上心情不好，而我不想揍人。

lines.en: : Yumi in a bad mood? How can this be?
lines.zh: : Yumi 心情不好？这怎么可能？

lines.en: : Hahah...I know, right? When has {i}that{/i} ever happened before?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……就是说啊，对吧？{i}这种事{/i}什么时候发生过？

lines.en: scene chikaclass3
: You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : I'm sure it might be hard for you to believe, but she isn’t {i}always{/i} like that.
lines.zh: : 我说出来你可能很难相信，但她并不{i}总是{/i}那样。

lines.en: : Yumi can actually be pretty chill when she's not surrounded by, like...school and people and all that stuff.
lines.zh: : Yumi 其实挺随和的，只要她周围没有……学校啊、人啊之类的东西。

lines.en: : She's just got a really short fuse and gets triggered way too easily. And whenever she does, it takes like, forever for her to come back down.
lines.zh: : 她只是脾气特别爆，太容易被点着。而且一旦点着了，要好久才能消下去。

lines.en: : Well, what {i}triggered{/i} her this time?
lines.zh: : 那这次是什么{i}点着{/i}她了？

lines.en: scene chikaclass4
: Ummm...
: Waking up?
lines.zh: : 起床？

lines.en: : Chika, that's not a short fuse. That is the complete absence of a fuse.
lines.zh: : Chika，那不叫脾气爆，那叫根本没有引信。

lines.en: : I know, I know. And usually I'm able to tell what it is. But she was like, super pissed the whole weekend and I still don't really get why.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。而且平时我是能看出原因的。但她整个周末都超级火大，我到现在也没搞明白为什么。

lines.en: : Like how am I supposed to cheer her up if she won't even tell me what's wrong?
lines.zh: : 她连出了什么事都不肯告诉我，我该怎么哄她啊？

lines.en: : No clue. Which is why I've pretty much just given up on trying to understand her in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不知道。所以我基本上已经放弃去理解她了。

lines.en: scene chikaclass5
: Well, I can’t really blame you for doing something like that...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这么做我也不能怪你……

lines.en: : But I do think that {i}you{/i} might be able to break through to her if you try hard enough.
lines.zh: : 但我确实觉得，如果{i}你{/i}足够努力，是有可能打动她的。

lines.en: : I think you might be misunderstanding my relationship with her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能误解了我跟她的关系。

lines.en: : Well, isn't it possible that you might be misunderstanding her a little bit too?
lines.zh: : 那么，有没有可能你也稍微误解了她一点呢？

lines.en: : I mean...I guess?
lines.zh: : 我是说……也许吧？

lines.en: : The thing with Yumi is...
lines.zh: : Yumi 的问题在于……

lines.en: scene chikaclass6
: Well, things for her haven't exactly been {i}easy.{/i} Let's just go with that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她过得并不{i}轻松{/i}。就这么说吧。

lines.en: : Honestly, even saying that much is more than she'd want me to tell you.
lines.zh: : 老实说，光是说这些，就已经超出她愿意让我告诉你的范围了。

lines.en: scene chikaclass5
: But, basically...she’s not just super mad all the time just because she thinks it makes her look cool or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不过，基本上……她不是因为觉得整天发火很酷之类的才那样的。

lines.en: : So what, though? It’s not like she’s the only person in the world going through tough times.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？她又不是这个世界上唯一在经历困境的人。

lines.en: : Her not having it easy shouldn't allow her to talk down on everyone else.
lines.zh: : 她过得不容易，也不该成为她贬低所有人的理由。

lines.en: : I know it probably sounds like an excuse...and I'm not saying that I think that she should get away with all of the stuff she does.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来像是在找借口……我也不是说她做的那些事就该被一笔勾销。

lines.en: : I just don’t want you thinking she’s some sort of lost cause.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你觉得她是个无可救药的人。

lines.en: : Like...if anyone was gonna break through to her, I think it would kinda {i}have{/i} to be you.
lines.zh: : 就像……如果有人能打动她，我觉得那多半{i}非你莫属{/i}。

lines.en: : Aren’t you her best friend? Why can’t you ‘break through to her?’
lines.zh: : 你不是她最好的朋友吗？为什么你不能「打动她」？

lines.en: scene chikaclass2
: Listen...I love the girl. But if I was gonna be the saving grace she needed, I would have already broken through by now.
lines.zh: : 听着……我很喜欢那丫头。但如果我是她需要的那个救星，早就打动她了。

lines.en: : I’m here to be her friend and support her, but what she needs is something a lot bigger than that.
lines.zh: : 我是来当她的朋友、支持她的，但她需要的东西可比这大得多。

lines.en: : And you seem pretty big to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 而老师你在我看来，还挺大的。

lines.en: I want that to be a euphemism but, based on the context of this conversation, I'm pretty confident it's not.
lines.zh: 我倒希望这是句双关，但结合这段对话的语境，我相当确定不是。

lines.en: : Like...what are you? 6’2 or something?
lines.zh: : 比如……你有多高？一米八八左右？

lines.en: I have now confirmed that it's not.
lines.zh: 现在确认了，不是。

lines.en: : Something like that. I'm not really the type to keep track of numbers.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。我不是那种会记数字的人。

lines.en: : Better be careful who you say stuff like that to, you know. The wrong person might...misinterpret that.
lines.zh: : 这种话你最好小心点跟谁说，知道吗。让不合适的人听到……可能会误会。

lines.en: : Maybe I want them to?
lines.zh: : 也许我就是想让他们误会呢？

lines.en: scene chikaclass7
: Ooooh...are you always this spicy in the morning? Or did I just happen to catch you on a good day?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦……你早上都这么带劲吗？还是说我碰巧赶上了你状态好的一天？

lines.en: : I like to think of it as less {i}spice{/i} and more of a...complete lack of a moral compass.
lines.zh: : 我更愿意把这看作不是{i}带劲{/i}，而是一种……完全缺失的道德指南针。

lines.en: scene chikaclass2
: Don't put yourself down like that. I know there's a great guy somewhere in that approximately 6'2ish body of yours.
lines.zh: : 别这么贬低自己。我知道在你那大约一米八八的身体里，藏着一个很不错的人。

lines.en: scene chikaclass8
: And I know you just told me you don't keep track of numbers, but do you think you could help out with this algebra stuff?
lines.zh: : 还有，我知道你刚说你不记数字，但你能不能帮我看看这道代数题？

lines.en: : I know you don't want to teach during the school day anymore, but...school {i}technically{/i} hasn't started yet. So it should be okay, right?
lines.zh: : 我知道你不想在上课时间教书了，可是……学校{i}严格来说{/i}还没开始上课呢。所以应该没问题吧？

lines.en: : What happens if I say it's not?
lines.zh: : 如果我说有问题呢？

lines.en: : I don't know. I'll probs just get held back again or something.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我大概又要留级之类的吧。

lines.en: : Again? You’ve been held back before?
lines.zh: : 又？你以前留过级？

lines.en: scene chikaclass1
: Wait, you didn't know that? I figured that would have been something they told you in the beginning of the year.
lines.zh: : 等等，你不知道吗？我以为这种事年初就会有人告诉你。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, uhh...I probably just forgot it then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那个，呃……那我大概只是忘了吧。

lines.en: Or...never learned it in the first place.
lines.zh: 或者……压根就没听说过。

lines.en: : What happened, exactly? If you're here early just to study and your attitude isn't that bad-
lines.zh: : 到底发生了什么事？如果你一大早来只是学习，而你的态度又不算差——

lines.en: if chikadorm15 == True:
scene chikaclass5
: Just...you know. The whole Chinami situation makes keeping up with school pretty tough sometimes.
lines.zh: : 就是……你知道的。Chinami 那件事，有时候让我很难跟上学业。

lines.en: : It's not exactly easy taking care of a kid at my age and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 在我这个年纪要照顾一个孩子，可不容易啊什么的。

lines.en: else:
scene chikaclass5
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I sorta had some stuff I needed to take care of. That's all.
lines.zh: : 我算是有一些必须处理的事情。就这样。

lines.en: : It’s not a big deal, really.
lines.zh: : 真不是什么大事。

lines.en: : And it’s gotten a lot easier to manage in the last year, so...
lines.zh: : 而且去年以来已经好处理多了，所以……

lines.en: scene chikaclass8r
: But hey, if worse comes to worst and I {i}do{/i} get held back again...maybe you'll be my teacher a second time?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，万一最坏的情况发生，我{i}真的{/i}又留级了……说不定你还能再当我一次老师？

lines.en: : Well, let’s hope it doesn’t come to that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，希望别走到那一步。

lines.en: : Also, if you ever need help with anything outside of[school]...I'm not entirely opposed, you know.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果你在[school]之外有任何需要帮忙的地方……我也不是完全不乐意，你知道的。

lines.en: scene chikaclass9
: Oh, no no no no no! I wasn't trying to ask for help or anything! You really don’t have to worry about me! I'm fine!
lines.zh: : 哦，不不不不不！我不是想求帮忙什么的！你真的不用担心我！我很好！

lines.en: : I’ve got everything totally under control. Seriously.
lines.zh: : 一切都完全在我的掌控之中。真的。

lines.en: : I’m sure you do. I’m just saying it’s okay to ask for help if you need it.
lines.zh: : 我相信你。我只是说，需要帮助的时候开口也没关系。

lines.en: scene chikaclass10
: Well...thanks, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……谢谢，老师……

lines.en: : I’ll try to remember that...
lines.zh: : 我会努力记住的……

lines.en: : Works for me. Just don't burn yourself out.
lines.zh: : 这样就行。只是别把自己累垮了。

lines.en: : Hey, umm...
: Do you mind if I ask you a, like...super weird question?
lines.zh: : 我能问你一个……有点奇怪的问题吗？

lines.en: : I...guess?
lines.zh: : 我……大概可以吧？

lines.en: : Okay, so like...
lines.zh: : 那个，就是……

lines.en: : What made you decide to get all...cool this far into the school year?
lines.zh: : 是什么让你决定在学期都过到这个时候了，突然变得这么……酷？

lines.en: : Like...you were totally different in the beginning of the year. Now, you're turning into somebody that pretty much {i}all{/i} of us admire.
lines.zh: : 就像……学期刚开始的时候你完全是另一个人。现在，你正在变成我们几乎{i}每个{/i}人都仰慕的那种人。

lines.en: : That's probably just one of the results of letting all of you slack off whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 那大概只是放任你们想偷懒就偷懒的结果之一。

lines.en: : No...No, I think it's more than that.
lines.zh: : 不……不，我觉得不止如此。

lines.en: : It's more like...you're a completely different-
lines.zh: : 更像是……你完全是另一个——

lines.en: scene chikaclass11
The bell chimes and saves me from having to answer a very difficult question.
lines.zh: 上课铃响了，替我省去了回答一个非常困难的问题的麻烦。

lines.en: : Wow...has it really been an hour already?
lines.zh: : 哇……已经过了一个小时了？

lines.en: : And I {i}still{/i} don't have my new password. I think it might be time for me to find a new teaching job.
lines.zh: : 而我{i}还{/i}没拿到新密码。我觉得我该去找份新的教职了。

lines.en: scene chikaclass12
: Ha. Good luck with that. I can't imagine any other schools in Kumon-mi accepting your {i}methods{/i} as easily as this one.
lines.zh: : 哈。祝你好运。我想象不出 Kumon-mi 还有哪所学校能像这儿一样轻易接受你的{i}那套做法{/i}。

lines.en: : For what it's worth, the {i}school{/i} hasn't accepted anything. It's just you girls who know about that.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，{i}学校{/i}并没有接受什么。知道那件事的只有你们这些女孩子。

lines.en: : Well, doesn't that make me feel special?...
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话还真让我受宠若惊啊……

lines.en: scene black
After a few minutes, the rest of the girls begin to filter in and yet another day of school begins.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，其他女生陆续进来，又一天的课程开始了。

lines.en: Chika never gets my help with algebra, but I'm sure she'll be fine on her own.
lines.zh: Chika 最终没能得到我代数上的帮助，但我相信她自己能搞定。

lines.en: if chikadorm15 == True:
She's already managed much harder things, after all...
lines.zh: 毕竟，比这更难的事她都已经扛过来了……

lines.en: else:
But, hey...if she doesn't-
lines.zh: 不过，嘿……要是她搞不定——

lines.en: I don't think I'd mind having her in my class for one more year.
lines.zh: 我想我也不会介意她在我的班上多待一年。

lines.en: $ day40 = True
$ chika_love += 1
{i}Chika's affection has increased to [chika_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Chika 的好感度提升到了 [chika_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
